project.name: Glenduckie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: The hamlet has genuine route value, assessed without transferring nearby Newburgh services. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. The A913 lay-by and village-hall/school parking advice is retained in the route notes rather than pinned as a guaranteed dedicated car park. No café, public toilet or managed picnic site was verified.
